description: This file implements a database driver for ADOdb, specifically handling a 'Plain Text' data source. It defines classes and functions for connecting to, querying, sorting, and managing in-memory text-based data within the ADOdb abstraction layer.

classes.name: ADODB_text
classes.description: A class representing a connection to a text-based data source within the ADOdb framework, providing methods for connecting, querying, and managing text data.

classes.name: ADODBRecordSet_text
classes.description: A class representing a record set for text data, extending from an array-based record set, allowing iteration over query results.

methods.name: RSRecordCount
methods.description: Returns the number of records in the result set.

methods.name: _affectedrows
methods.description: Indicates whether rows were affected. Always returns false for this driver.

methods.name: PConnect
methods.description: Establishes a persistent connection to the text data source.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Connects to the in-memory text data, initializing structure and type inference.
